# ADRRR

> Adrian Ng's trading and investing site. Morning Report, a congressional-trading tracker, and a TD Sequential backtest. Research and education, not investment advice.

The public site is https://news-chart.com. Pages are static HTML on Cloudflare Pages. Crawlers may fetch every public URL. `/api/` is not a public page. There is no site search. Discovery files: `/robots.txt`, `/sitemap.xml` (a sitemap index), and `/news/feed.xml` (RSS for Morning Report editions). Daily Morning Report editions are `/news/YYYYMMDD/`.

## Sections

- [Home](https://news-chart.com/): Landing page. The latest Morning Report lead, a market tape, and doors into each section.
- [Backtest](https://news-chart.com/backtest/): Run TD Sequential or ATR SuperTrend on daily history, and HSI futures on 1-minute and 5-minute bars. The chart, profit curve, and statistics run in the browser.
- [Politician Tracker](https://news-chart.com/politician-tracker/): STOCK Act disclosures from a VIP list of members of Congress, plus any member's trade in a Watchlist ticker. Refreshed about 07:05 HKT. Members are listed on this one page; there is no separate URL per member unless a static member page is published later.
- [Morning Report](https://news-chart.com/news/): The daily market briefing, published around 08:15 HKT, and its archive. Each edition is `/news/YYYYMMDD/`.
- [Morning Report RSS](https://news-chart.com/news/feed.xml): One item per edition that exists under `/news/YYYYMMDD/`. Titles, links, and descriptions come from those pages. A publish time is included only when the page already has one.

`/hsi-lab/` redirects to [Backtest](https://news-chart.com/backtest/) with the HSI futures SuperTrend recipe. That is the only strategy lab URL.

## Discovery

- [Sitemap index](https://news-chart.com/sitemap.xml): Points at the page sitemap and, when editions exist, the news archive sitemap. A Google News sitemap is added for editions from today or yesterday in Hong Kong.
- [RSS](https://news-chart.com/news/feed.xml): Morning Report editions only. Written when the site is assembled with `news/`.
- [robots.txt](https://news-chart.com/robots.txt): Allows all crawlers, names the major search and AI crawlers, and disallows `/api/`.
